main.title: Profile
text: Third-year computer engineering student interested in infrastructure and automation. I manage the servers of our student club and want to learn how production systems are run.

items.heading: System Admin (volunteer) — Student Club
bullets: Maintain an Ubuntu VPS running the club website and a Discord bot.
Moved the services into Docker containers with docker-compose.
Wrote shell scripts for nightly backups.

items.heading: Raspberry Pi Monitoring
bullets: Collected temperature and uptime metrics with a Python script and visualised them in Grafana.
